question: What is the average area of the baseball fields given a GSD of 0.791?
final_answer_preview:
The average area of the baseball field in the image, calculated using the provided Ground Sample Distance (GSD) of 0.791 meters per pixel, is approximately **398,436.16 square meters**.

This calculation was derived by:
1. Determining the bounding box dimensions (798 pixels × 798 pixels) from the detected baseball field.
2. Converting pixel dimensions to real-world area using the GSD:  
   $$
   \text{Area} = (\text{Width in pixels} \times \text{Height in pixels}) \times (\text{GSD}^2)
   $$
